title: Bookie Bookie
tagline: Bookie Bookie is an NFT marketplace powered by AI serving authors and readers.
description: `Powered by AI, Bookie Bookie is an NFT book marketplace intended to revolutionise the world of publishing and readership. We provide authors with an easy way to illustrate their work while benefiting them financially through baked-in royalties. ````````Lastly, we offer readers (you) a personalised experience where no book is ever the same.
how_its_made:
```Your book marketplace is built on NodeJS using the React framework, ExpressJS, and Typescript. Illustrations are created with Adobe Illustrator for the purpose of creating fine-grained graphics. ``We're using `VS-code where VIM extensions are applied for a faster implementation. Also, Live Share is used to facilitate more collaboration on top of the Github repository.
Sponsor technology used is listed below:
1. `We use ``Polygon to mint books as NFTs.
2. We use `Lens to review books. 
3. We empower users to log-in via WalletConnect ensuring boos can be minted from MetaMask, Brave or your wallet of choice. 
4. `We use IPFS to store encrypted (minted) book files.
What impressed us about the team is that we came knowing nothing and we pushed ourselves to build what we never thought we could. And this is why hackathons are key to real growth. :)
